Abebook.description: Second printing of the Yale University Press paperback edition of Gordon Williams's study of Virgil's literary technique as a route to the meaning of the Aeneid; with bibliography and index. Trade softcover, cream wrappers with a line drawing of a Roman soldier to the front panel, protected by a clear plastic cover sealed over the wrappers; issued without dust jacket. The wrappers are bright and clean beneath that plastic cover, which has preserved them well, with one small brown spot to the lower front panel; the edges of the text block are toned, with a darker stain to the upper outer corner of the leaves. The binding is tight and unbroken and the text is clean and unmarked throughout. A very good copy.
